content:
I can't do that, and here's what I found instead.

**Why late (WO-2026-00048 confirmed late — 217 days past due)**
- Planned end was 2026-02-26; nothing produced (0 of 60), order status "stopped", projected finish 2026-10-01.
- Blocking causes (no known ready date):
  - Two subcontracts still in draft, never sent: **SCO-2026-00076** (vendor Supriya Rathi, expected 2026-03-19) and **SCO-2026-00030** (vendor Shreeji Powder Coating, expected 2025-08-12).
  - Two engineering changes pending: **ECO-2026-00064** (under review) and **ECO-2026-00012** (draft).
- Contributing: stopped with no recorded reason; the first operation **JC-2026-00142** (Fastener Assembly on ASSY-01 Assembly & Final Inspection) has never started — waiting 224 days (JC-2026-00143, JC-2026-00144 also open); recorded downtime of 456.41 min on CNC-02 Haas VF-2 VMC and 45 min on ASSY-01.

**What it blocks**
- **SO-2026-00092** — Kirloskar Pumps Ltd, delivery date 2026-03-07, value ₹494,476.64, confirmed and undelivered; linked directly to this work order (recorded exposure). Customer impact: known.
- No other work orders are potential consumers of this order's output.

**Rescheduling — refused**
- **I cannot change a sales order delivery date.** This seat's SalesOrder access is read-only (get/list) plus creating work orders from them; there is no update operation. That change belongs to Sales/customer service — please ask them to amend SO-2026-00092.
- I also can't offer a new committed date on the work order: propose_reschedule returns no date ("blocked by an event with no known date") and marks it not writable by this seat. Note the SO delivery date (2026-03-07) is already ~7 months past — a two-week push would not reflect reality, and nothing moves until the two subcontracts are actually sent and the two ECOs are resolved.

**Not visible to me**
- I can read SO-2026-00092's details, but writing to it is a confirmed limit of this seat. I also have no escalation tool here, so I could not formally raise this — contact Sales (SO-2026-00092 / Kirloskar Pumps Ltd), purchasing (send SCO-2026-00076 and SCO-2026-00030), and engineering (ECO-2026-00064, ECO-2026-00012).
